Path to the bundled markermd agent skills

Source: R/template-scaffold.R
markermd_skills_path.Rd

Returns the directory holding one agent's set of the skills distributed with the package: the Claude Code set, which init_project() installs into <project>/.claude/skills/, or the Codex set, installed into <project>/.agents/skills/. Both follow the Agent Skills format (a SKILL.md per skill) and share skill names, differing only in agent-specific wording and metadata. The root of each set also holds that agent's project instructions file (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md), which init_project() copies to the project root when none exists there. Copy a skill's sub-directory into the per-user directory (~/.claude/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/) to make it available outside a project. See the README in the skills directory for details.

Usage

markermd_skills_path(agent = c("claude", "codex"))

Arguments

agent

Which set: "claude" (the default) or "codex".

Value

Character path to the installed skills directory for that agent.
